holder: 芝加哥艺术博物馆（藏品号 1958.222a-b）
medium: Hard-paste porcelain, glaze, with enamels in colors, and gilding
one_line: 芝加哥艺术博物馆藏陶瓷，馆方断代作「c. 1784–95」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: Artist unknown (Chinese, made for the American market)；China
Hard-paste porcelain, glaze, with enamels in colors, and gilding

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录芝加哥艺术博物馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：年代 1784–1795 唯一落入 qing；器类归入依据仅为：type=Ceramics。

dating.text: 馆方给出了年代，**但未在公开记录中说明这个年代依据什么**——是铭文、器形序列、共出器物还是风格比对，无从得知。本库的断代十档因此无法填写：**填任何一档都是替馆方作了它没作的声明。**

provenance.title: Art Institute of Chicago, China-Trade Porcelain from the Frederick S. Colburn Collection, Feb. 1–July 31, 1957, no cat.

provenance.when: 见馆方档案原文（未分段）
provenance.text: Grace S. Fish (1862-1946; born Grace Studebaker; also Mrs. Frederick S. Fish), South Bend, IN, by Jan. 1940; to her children, Frederick S. Fish, Jr. and Mrs. Jane Fish Ballard, by Jan. 5, 1940; sold, Parke-Bernet Galleries, New York, Jan. 5-6, 1940, lot 438 [sales cat.; copy in curatorial object file]. Frederick Standish Colburn (1878–1957), Evanston, IL, by Jan. 29, 1957 [incoming receipt, RX2123, Jan. 29, 1957; copy in curatorial object file]; bequeathed to the Art Institute of Chicago, 1958.
